versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת־אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,
controles.kjv: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR respondeu mais a Jó, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הֲ֭רֹב עִם־שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃פ

controles.web: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
controles.kjv: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
controles.livre: Por acaso quem briga contra o Todo-Poderoso pode ensiná-lo? Quem quer repreender a Deus, responda a isto.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Then Job answered Yahweh,
controles.kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
controles.livre: Então Jó respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִֽי׃

controles.web: “Behold, I am of small account. What shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
controles.kjv: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
controles.livre: Eis que eu sou insignificante; o que eu te responderia? Ponho minha mão sobre minha boca.

versos.hebraico: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף׃פ

controles.web: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
controles.kjv: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
controles.livre: Uma vez falei, porém não responderei; até duas vezes, porém não prosseguirei.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעַן־יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב מנ סערה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
controles.kjv: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR respondeu a Jó desde o redemoinho, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אֱזָר־נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
controles.kjv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
controles.livre: Cinge-te agora os teus lombos como homem; eu te perguntarei, e tu me explica.

versos.hebraico: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃

controles.web: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
controles.kjv: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
controles.livre: Por acaso tu anularias o meu juízo? Tu me condenarias, para te justificares?

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל׀ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃

controles.web: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
controles.kjv: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
controles.livre: Tens tu braço como Deus? Ou podes tu trovejar com tua voz como ele?

versos.hebraico: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃

controles.web: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
controles.kjv: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
controles.livre: Orna-te, pois, de excelência e alteza; e veste-te de majestade e glória.

versos.hebraico: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל־גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
controles.kjv: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
controles.livre: Espalha os furores de tua ira; olha a todo soberbo, e abate-o.

versos.hebraico: רְאֵ֣ה כָל־גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

controles.web: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
controles.kjv: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
controles.livre: Olha a todo soberbo, e humilha-o; e esmaga aos perversos em seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃

controles.web: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
controles.kjv: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
controles.livre: Esconde-os juntamente no pó; ata seus rostos no oculto.

versos.hebraico: וְגַם־אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
controles.kjv: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
controles.livre: E eu também te reconhecerei; pois tua mão direita te terá livrado.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃

controles.web: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
controles.kjv: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
controles.livre: Observa o beemote,  ao qual eu fiz contigo; ele come erva come como o boi.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה־נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
controles.kjv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
controles.livre: Eis que sua força está em seus lombos, e seu poder na musculatura de seu ventre.

versos.hebraico: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ־אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פחדו יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃

controles.web: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
controles.kjv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
controles.livre: Ele torna sua cauda dura como o cedro, e os nervos de suas coxas são entretecidos.

versos.hebraico: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃

controles.web: His bones are like tubes of brass. His limbs are like bars of iron.
controles.kjv: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
controles.livre: Seus ossos são como tubos de bronze; seus membros, como barras de ferro.

versos.hebraico: ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי־אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
controles.kjv: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
controles.livre: Ele é a obra-prima dos caminhos de Deus; aquele que o fez o proveu de sua espada.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־ל֑וֹ וְֽכָל־חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ־שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
controles.kjv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
controles.livre: Pois os montes lhe produzem pasto; por isso todos os animais do campo ali se alegram.

versos.hebraico: תַּֽחַת־צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃

controles.web: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
controles.kjv: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
controles.livre: Ele se deita debaixo das árvores sombrias; no esconderijo das canas e da lama.

versos.hebraico: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָֽחַל׃

controles.web: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
controles.kjv: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
controles.livre: As árvores sombrias o cobrem, cada uma com sua sombra; os salgueiros do ribeiro o cercam.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח׀ כִּֽי־יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל־פִּֽיהוּ׃

controles.web: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
controles.kjv: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
controles.livre: Ainda que o rio se torne violento, ele não se apressa; confia ainda que o Jordão transborde até sua boca.

versos.hebraico: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב־אָֽף׃

controles.web: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
controles.kjv: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
controles.livre: Poderiam, por acaso, capturá-lo à vista de seus olhos, ou com laços furar suas narinas?

versos.hebraico: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
controles.kjv: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
controles.livre: Poderás tu pescar ao leviatã com anzol, ou abaixar sua língua com uma corda?

versos.hebraico: הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמ֣וֹן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ תִּקּ֥וֹב לֶֽחֱיוֹ׃

controles.web: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
controles.kjv: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
controles.livre: Podes pôr um anzol em seu nariz, ou com um espinho furar sua queixada?

versos.hebraico: הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם־יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
controles.kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
controles.livre: Fará ele súplicas a ti, ou falará contigo suavemente?

versos.hebraico: הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
controles.kjv: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
controles.livre: Fará ele pacto contigo, para que tu o tomes por escravo perpétuo?

versos.hebraico: הַֽתְשַׂחֶק־בּ֭וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
controles.kjv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
controles.livre: Brincarás tu com ele como com um passarinho, ou o atarás para tuas meninas?

versos.hebraico: יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים׃

controles.web: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
controles.kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
controles.livre: Os companheiros farão banquete dele? Repartirão dele entre os mercadores?

versos.hebraico: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת עוֹר֑וֹ וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל דָּגִ֣ים רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
controles.kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
controles.livre: Poderás tu encher sua pele de espetos, ou sua cabeça com arpões de pescadores?

versos.hebraico: שִׂים־עָלָ֥יו כַּפֶּ֑ךָ זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל־תּוֹסַֽף׃

controles.web: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
controles.kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
controles.livre: Põe tua mão sobre ele; te lembrarás da batalha, e nunca mais voltarás a fazer.
